messages.subject: Project Ember — initial title & lease queries
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Thank you for the data-room access. Having reviewed the official copies for NGL612904 and the lease bundle, a few initial points:

1. The charges register shows the Clydesford Bank charge — please confirm this will be discharged on completion and whether a DS1 or undertaking will be provided.
2. We note the 1953 restrictive covenants; do you hold any consents or have any been sought?
3. Please confirm the rent deposit figures — we have £196k (Aldous) and £122,400 (Brindley).
4. The Calderfield arrears of £14,300 — is the tenant in correspondence?
5. Please confirm the option to tax position and provide HMRC's acknowledgement.

We'll send formal CPSE.1 and supplementals this week.

Best
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Project Ember — initial title & lease queries
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Thanks. Quick answers ahead of the formal CPSE replies:
1. Yes — discharge on completion; undertaking if the DS1 isn't through in time.
2. No consents sought; the covenants are old and we're not aware of any enforcement. Happy for you to consider indemnity insurance.
3. Deposit figures confirmed.
4. Calderfield is in correspondence; arrears to be apportioned.
5. Option to tax effective 1 April 2015; HMRC acknowledgement is in the data room at 8.01.

Full CPSE.1 replies to follow.

Rachel
